title: 原生LowCardinality编码：保留字符串语义并接受后续新类别，不冒充固定Enum

CREATE TABLE labels(id UInt32,label LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY id;

 <background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>1</background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>1</background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_pool_size>2</background_pool_size>
 <merge_tree>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>
 </merge_tree>
</clickhouse>'''

class Local:
 def __init__(self):
  self.executable=shutil.which('clickhouse')
  if not self.executable:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: ClickHouse Local 25.8.1.5101 executable missing')
  result=subprocess.run([self.executable,'local','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
  if result.returncode or '25.8.1.5101' not in result.stdout:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: pinned ClickHouse Local version required')
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-clickhouse-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.config=self.root/'config.xml';self.config.write_text(CONFIG,encoding='utf8');return self
 def run(self,sql,*,data=None,structure=None,table='source',input_format='JSONEachRow'):
  args=[self.executable,'local','--config-file='+str(self.config),'--path='+str(self.root/'data'),'--multiquery','--format=JSONEachRow',
   '--max_threads=2','--max_memory_usage=134217728','--output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers=0','--query='+sql]

title: 原生精确去重人数：计费口径不能用近似uniq或原始行数替代
answer:
```sql
SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM visitors;
```

原题知识说明：
uniq是近似去重计数，uniqExact追求精确但内存可能随不同值数增长。按误差预算和峰值基数选择，用已知集合对照验证。

title: 原生精确下中位数：先固定偶数样本约定，再选择quantile函数
answer:
```sql
SELECT quantileExactLow(0.5)(latency) AS p50 FROM source;
```

原题知识说明：
不同函数采用不同算法，精度、确定性和内存成本不同。明确近似或精确要求，使用同数据对照并记录误差，不能把p99显示位数当精度证明。
